title: Computational discovery and evaluation of berbamunine as a potential therapeutic agent targeting YAP-driven schwannoma.
authors: Ameer, Tooba; Khan, Haris Ahmed; Ahmad, Nouman
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟评估小分子药物与YAP1蛋白的结合，虽涉及蛋白靶点但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Schwannoma, a tumour arising from Schwann cells, is frequently driven by aberrant activation of the Yes-associated protein 1 (YAP1), particularly in NF2-associated cases. This study explores the potential of Berbamunine, a bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloid from Berberis species, as a YAP1-targeting therapeutic agent. A comprehensive computational pipeline was employed, incorporating ADME profiling, drug-likeness assessment, toxicity prediction, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and binding free energy calculations. Berbamunine demonstrated high gastrointestinal absorption, low predicted toxicity, and strong binding affinity to YAP1 (-8.4 kcal/mol), with stable interactions confirmed through 100 ns MD simulations and MM/PBSA analysis (DeltaG = -29.33 kcal/mol). Systems biology analyses including PASS prediction, network pharmacology, KEGG pathway mapping, and Gene Ontology enrichment analysis suggests that Berbamunine may interact multiple oncogenic signalling pathways associated with YAP-driven Schwannoma. These findings indicate Berbamunine has potential to inhibit YAP1-driven oncogenic processes in Schwannoma. This study provides a strong computational foundation for further experimental validation and therapeutic development.
abstract_zh: 神经鞘瘤（Schwannoma）是一种源自施万细胞（Schwann cells）的肿瘤，其发生常由Yes相关蛋白1（YAP1）的异常激活驱动，尤其在NF2相关病例中。本研究探讨了小檗属（Berberis species）来源的双苄基异喹啉生物碱Berbamunine作为靶向YAP1治疗药物的潜力。采用综合计算流程，包括ADME分析、药物相似性评估、毒性预测、分子对接、分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟及结合自由能计算。Berbamunine表现出高胃肠道吸收、低预测毒性及对YAP1的强结合亲和力（-8.4 kcal/mol），并通过100 ns MD模拟和MM/PBSA分析（DeltaG = -29.33 kcal/mol）确认了稳定相互作用。系统生物学分析，包括PASS预测、网络药理学、KEGG通路映射及基因本体富集分析，提示Berbamunine可能作用于与YAP驱动的神经鞘瘤相关的多个致癌信号通路。这些发现表明，Berbamunine具有抑制神经鞘瘤中YAP1驱动的致癌过程的潜力。本研究为进一步的实验验证和治疗开发提供了坚实的计算基础。
